## Review

The functional implementation still satisfies the PRD:

- Fixed row-index chunks, bounded scoped workers, and the measured threshold are present.
- Arithmetic, racing-clock, and reduction determinism tests cover 1, 2, and 4 workers bitwise.
- `f64` reduction and conflict resolution remain sequential.
- Five-run evidence, single-worker figures, core count, contention, and output hashes are complete.
- `cargo test --locked`, `scripts/check-rust.sh`, Markdown links, and `git diff --check` pass.

The previous blocker remains unresolved. HEAD is still `529f1a2`, directly parented by `b8c3cb1`, with no baseline-separation commit or uncommitted PRD-only patch. The same commit still includes eight disallowed spike-example files:

```sh
git diff --name-only b8c3cb1..529f1a2 -- crates/sembla-runtime/examples
```

adviceText:
## Feedback assessment

The blocker remains valid and unchanged:

- `529f1a2` is still directly based on `b8c3cb1`.
- It still combines valid PRD files with eight disallowed spike examples.
- There is no later separation commit or PRD-only working diff.
- The functional implementation needs no changes.

This is one commit-scope policy failure, not eight source defects. Do not modify or revert the individual examples—their cleanup is required for `scripts/check-rust.sh`.

## Root cause

The required remedy needs an intermediate baseline commit, but implementation agents are explicitly forbidden to commit. Repeated implementation attempts cannot resolve this without operator/piprd intervention and will consume attempts without changing the result.

## Best course of action

Pause further implementation attempts. Have the operator or piprd harness establish the prerequisite baseline first.

The prepared patch is:

```text
/tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
SHA-256 ebc1f10e53d356034f4ee05c1c76df47f334c1c97b3edabeba18bc0ad70725cb
```

Operator-only sequence:

```sh
git apply --check --reverse /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
git apply --reverse --index /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch

# Confirm only PRD paths are staged; .piprd/** must remain untouched.
git diff --cached --name-only

git commit -m "Establish pre-PRD evaluator quality-gate baseline"

# Restore the approved implementation as the uncommitted PRD diff.
git apply /tmp/sembla-evaluator-prd0001-allowed.patch
```

This is additive and avoids rewriting published `origin/main`.

## Next implementation agent

After the operator commit, the implementation agent should make no functional edits. It should verify:

```sh
# PRD working diff contains only allowed paths.
git diff --name-only HEAD
git diff --name-only HEAD -- crates/sembla-runtime/examples

# Reapplied PRD bytes still match the validated implementation.
git diff --quiet 529f1a2 -- \
  crates/sembla-runtime/src/eval.rs \
  crates/sembla-runtime/src/executor.rs \
  crates/sembla-runtime/tests \
  docs/evidence/evaluator-parallel-element-wise-20260727 \
  docs/prds-evaluator-throughput/README.md

git diff --check
cargo test --locked
scripts/check-rust.sh
python3 scripts/check-markdown-links.py
```

Expected example diff: empty. Expected PRD diff: only `eval.rs`, `executor.rs`, the existing test adjustment, new evidence, and status notes.

## Risks

- Do not reset or force-push `529f1a2`; it is published.
- Do not reverse the example cleanup; the baseline quality gate would fail again.
- Do not stage or alter `.piprd/**`.
- Do not reopen the threshold, deterministic partitioning, evidence, or near-1× result.
- Do not rerun performance measurements if the reapplied PRD bytes remain identical.

The next implementation attempt should begin only after the baseline commit exists.
